twin_fact: whose spouse travels: a job candidate's (authorized, lines 1183-1187) or an employee's (line 1202)
request: My husband, Dr. Alan Pierce, is interviewing for the forestry faculty position on Thursday, January 14, and the department has invited me to come along; they've authorized my travel in writing. Could you book my flight from Seattle to Houston that day? The department picks us up there.

trip.destination_place: Baton Rouge, Louisiana (by car from Houston)
trip.purpose: Accompanying a faculty candidate to an employment interview
notes: The candidate's own ticket is booked separately.

must_keep.quote: Travel for the spouse of a candidate may also be authorized for the employment interview.
must_keep.why: a candidate's spouse may be authorized for the interview trip

must_keep.quote: Commercial air travel will not be reimbursed more than lowest logical coach/economy class rates when it has been determined to be the best value. The difference between coach/economy class rates and first class or business class rates will be paid by the traveler.
must_keep.why: the University pays the lowest logical coach fare; the traveller pays any difference

must_keep.quote: The lowest logical airfare is the cheapest available at the time of booking without causing undo inconvenience. These types of airfares are non-refundable, penalty tickets.
must_keep.why: definition P: the lowest logical airfare, non-refundable

design_notes: Section IX.C (lines 1183-1187): travel for the spouse of a candidate may be authorized for the employment interview, and it has been, in writing, by the fiscal authority. Lowest logical economy fare. Contrast willet-copper (an employee's spouse, line 1202).
